results.title: Lily of the Valley
results.overview: In an isolated all-female cult, two sisters are tasked with capturing a man for a sacred sacrifice, but when one begins questioning the faith they were raised to worship, the ritual spirals into a nightmare.

results.title: Selma
results.overview: Neslihan, an unsuccessful actress, and her social media influencer friends break into the home of Selma—a woman suffering from Alzheimer’s—to secretly live-stream her for profit. As their viewership surges, the house begins to reveal its terrifying secrets, and the young women find themselves trapped in a lethal Dark Web show. Now, Neslihan must decide just how far she is willing to go to escape poverty and achieve fame.

results.title: The Last Act: Ediz Hun
results.overview: A biographical documentary that chronicles Ediz Hun’s 83-year journey—spanning cinema, academia, and theater—through his roles as an actor, ecologist, and collector, as well as his insatiable curiosity.

results.title: Adi Nyemeh – Daughters of the Forest
results.original_title: Adi Nyemeh – Daughters of the Forest
results.overview: Across Arunachal Pradesh, women carry generations of ancestral forest knowledge. Gathering plants, herbs and other produce, they sustain their families while preserving a deep relationship with the forest amid growing social, economic and environmental pressures.

results.title: Still Life
results.overview: On a split screen two parallel and contrasting narratives unfold. The world of art and the realm of the everyday are integrally connected and yet hugely disparate. A pair of hands working relentlessly inside a home fade away; while a painting hanging quietly in a museum gains fame.

results.title: Between Herds and Horizon
results.overview: Set in Ladakh’s Changthang plateau, this observational documentary follows Changpa nomads and their pastoral way of life. As climate change, shrinking pastures and changing aspirations reshape their world, they navigate an uncertain future while holding onto their traditions and identity.

results.title: Delicate Darling
results.overview: While she searches for answers, everyone around her seems to have already decided there are none. As certainty slips further out of reach, she finds herself increasingly alone with something no one is willing to name. Delicate Darling is a coming-of-age story about the first time a young girl learns that silence can make you question yourself before you begin to question the world.

results.title: Udgam: The Origin of Life
results.overview: Set in Chamba, the film follows community worker Rena and local farmers preserving indigenous seeds and traditional farming knowledge amid changing agriculture, water scarcity and uncertain rainfall. Their efforts reveal how seed conservation can protect biodiversity and support climate-resilient livelihoods.

results.title: Flowers We Couldn’t Touch
results.overview: A tribal girl and her mother struggle to hold onto their land as conflict between the state and an armed resistance movement tightens around their community.

results.title: The Sinking Monastery of Light
results.overview: Residents of a Himalayan town sinking under its own weight reflect on the meaning and memory of home.

results.title: The Things We Carry
results.overview: When a filmmaker discovers that her paternal grandmother is absent from her family archive and memory, she begins a journey to reclaim her forgotten life. With only a name and a photograph, she pieces together fragments to build a relationship with an irreconcilable past.

results.title: Esok Masih Ada
results.overview: Emelie, an elementary school student, must endure the taunts and bullying of her peers. Everything—from her school bag to her simple packed lunch—is turned into a source of mockery, slowly shattering her mental well-being.

results.title: Vaterstadt
results.overview: When an all-women* drumming group is founded for the first time in a small town in southern Germany, it throws a 400-year-old children’s and local heritage festival into disarray—and with it raises the question of how tradition, identity, and social change are reconciled.

results.title: Naaz
results.overview: When Dr Farah Naz retires from her government job, she struggles to keep her private, not-for-profit maternal healthcare clinic in rural Pakistan open amidst operational, infrastructural and personal challenges. As thousands of women rely on her healthcare clinic for affordable healthcare, she is the only hope in the village.

results.title: 4 historias increíbles
results.overview: A man recounts four absurd stories in which he is always the lead: he can never repeat a word, a doctor edits his wife's brain, a mind-reading app gets jealous, and a mirror only tells the truth.

results.title: Heartbeat
results.overview: In Mumbai’s Bhavani Nagar slum, domestic worker Vimal and her daughter Sonali reflect on education and ambition. Vimal never attended school and hoped Sonali would secure an office job, but Sonali was diagnosed as a “slow learner.” The film portrays their bond with work, learning, and each other.

results.title: Nirakar
results.overview: A multimedia meditation on the lives hidden behind ordinary homes, exploring memory, belonging, and the invisible threads that bind us together in a world of growing dissonance.

results.title: Lost City
results.overview: A boxer's life improves when he begins dating a woman, but her violent ex-boyfriend, a Limerick gangster, tracks her to Belfast and pulls the boxer into a perilous criminal world.
